raw_segments.text: But in those places where the presbytery took that office, though many other doctrines of
the Church of Rome were forbidden to be taught, yet this doctrine, that the kingdom of Christ
is already come, and that it began at the resurrection of our Saviour, was still retained.
But Cuy Bono, what profit did they expect from it, the same which the popes expected,
to have a sobering power over the people?
For what is it for men to excommunicate their lawful king, but to keep him from all places
of God's public service in his own kingdom, and with force to resist him, when he with
force and devereth to correct them?
